records.note: Hyo-Jun Park (2014 signing tracker spelling) and Hoy Jun Park / Hoy Park (MLB record) are the same player: the MLB transaction is a Yankees signing of a shortstop on the 2014 period's opening day, and the MLB person record's birth country is South Korea, matching the tracker's club, period, position and country. Linked on that evidence, not on name similarity.
